findings.current: At the deaths of fully two thousand of their comrades, felled before they could take their first step in Henan.
findings.defect: The source explicitly says that all they could do was stare blankly at the deaths. The assembled English omits that reaction.
findings.rationale: The Korean states, “그들이 할 수 있는 일이라곤, 그저 멍하니 바라보는 것뿐이었다”—that all they could do was simply stare blankly.
findings.replacement: All they could do was stare, dumbfounded, at the deaths of fully two thousand of their comrades, felled before they could take their first step in Henan.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it omits the survivors’ explicit reaction of staring dumbfounded at their fallen comrades.
